job.job_title: Senior Software Engineer - .NET Full Stack+ AI (AGENTIC AI/RAG/LLM)
job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain large-scale software applications using .NET Core.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify requirements and implement solutions that meet business needs.
Develop high-quality APIs using REST architecture and integrate them with Kafka messaging queues for real-time data processing.
Ensure scalability, security, performance, and reliability of the system by following best practices in software engineering.

Job Requirements :

8-14 years of experience as a Full Stack .NET Developer or similar role.
Strong proficiency in C#, ASP.NET, React.JS/Vue.JS/Angular for frontend development.
Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud platform including containerization (e.g., Docker), serverless computing (e.g., Functions), storage solutions (e.g., Blob).
Familiarity with Agentic AI's Large Language Model for natural language processing tasks such as text retrieval augmented generation.
